title: CaRe High - Cascade Screening and Registry for High Cholesterol
summary: Main goal of the study is the identification of patients with inherited elevated cholesterol levels (familial hypercholesterolemia). Data about the progress of the disease and therapy will be collected. Cascade screening to identify other affected people in the family of the patient will be initiated. The risk for Heart Disease at young age can be decreased by early treatment of the elevated cholesterol level.

interventions.name: When included into the registry and at follow up after 18 month and 5 years patients with familial hypercholesterolemia are questioned about their medical history, their family history and therapy. In addition the physician anwers an initial questionnaire about relevant lab and other test results.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
LDL-cholesterol >190mg/dl without lipid-lowering therapy; cholesterol >290 mg/dl without lipid-lowering therapy; tendon xanthomas; positive family history for hypercholesterolemia; positive family history for myocard infarct before the age of 50 for grand-parents, uncle, aunts or before the age of 60 for parents, siblings and children; first and second degree relatives of patients with FH
Exclusion criteria:
refusal of written consent of participation in the study; obvious impairment of cognitive functions; decompensated, acute psychiatric diseases; acute non-cardio-vascular disease, non-cardio-vascular surgeries within the last three months, chronic non-cardiac diseases (e.g. chronic kidney failure, rheumatoide arthritis, cancer during the last 5 years); people, not able to understand the meaning of the study
